title.rendered: Boulder Ridge Golf Club San Jose Wedding DJ Pavilion Event Center

content.rendered:
JOEY & ROMA WEDDING SEPTEMBER 2nd 2013.

DJ & PHOTO BOOTH

CEREMONY

Ceremony Rhythm of Love Plain White T’s Bridal Party Entrance

Song Title Artist Notes

Best Thing Anthem lights Roma Entrance – CEREMONY

1,2,3,4 Plain White T’s Joey/Roma, Bridal Party Exit – CEREMONY

Reception I Do Colbie Caillat Introducing the Bridal Party & Newlyweds

I’ll Be Edwin McCain JOEY/ROMA First dance

Single Ladies Beyonce Bouquet Toss

Cherry Pie Warrant Garter Toss

My wish Rascal Flatts Parent/Child dance

Better Together Jack Johnson Reception Last dance

Cocktail/Dinner Wonderful world Louis Armstrong

A Thousand Years Christina Perri

Amazed Lonestar

Love Story Taylor Swift

The Way You Look Tonight Frank Sinatra

I Do (Cherish You) 98 Degrees

First Dance Corey Smith

History in the making Darius Rucker

Truly, Madly, Deeply Savage Garden

This I promise you Anthem Lights

Because you loved me Celine Dion

And other dinner music like this…

Party Music I Got Friends in Low Places Garth Brooks

Don’t Stop Believing Journey

Blurred Lines Robin Thicke

Clarity Zedd

Party/Dance music should be majority Top 40 hits, with a mix of a few country songs & oldies

VENUE: Boulder Ridge Golf Club, 1000 Old Quarry Rd, San Jose, CA

Bride & Groom: Roma Zhu & Joseph Monts

WEDDING ITINERARY

 

4.00pm DJ ARRIVE @ BR to setup

5.05pm Ceremony starts

5.30pm Ceremony ends – GROUP PICS

5:40pm Cocktail hour begins

6.30pm Doors open for dinner

6.45pm Guests seated, Entrance for WEDDING PARTY, see below for details…

6.50pm Salad served, Announce Game #1 (Show me your love) can be played throughout the night

6.55pm Speech Ryan (Best Man)

7.05pm Speech Jackie (Maid of Honor)

7.10pm Collect dishes, serve Main Course, give guests time to eat and chatter

7.20pm Speech Joey’s Parents

7.30pm Speech Roma’s Parents

7.40pm Clear main dishes

7.45pm CUT CAKE, then FIRST DANCE

 

7.50pm Dessert served, coffee served – ANNOUNCE: any guests that want to make a toast are welcome to at this time

8.00pm Speech Joey, then Roma

8.20pm Bouquet Toss, Garter Toss, GAMES!!! (Game details below)

8.40pm Father/Daughter Dance, after end of first chorus, Mother/Son join, after 2nd chorus, indicate that the Newlyweds invite guests to join them on the dance floor

8.45pm DANCING!!!

11.00pm VENDOR TAKEDOWN – have 1 hr

11.30pm Last shuttle
